claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Africa, Captain Anderson,
which left Liverpool at four o'clock P. M. on the 26th
via Queenstown 27th ult., arrived at Halifax at six
o'clock yesterday morning en route to Boston.

New York Herald, 7 June 1866, p. 4, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The steamship Africa, from Queenstown May 27,
reached Halifax yesterday, on her voyage to Boston, at
which port she will be due to-morrow morning. Her
news is two days later.

HALIFAX, June 6.—The steamship Africa,
with Liverpool dates to the 26th ult., has ar-
rived.

Latest per Africa.
LIVERPOOL, May 25th, Evening.—Cotton
firmer, but unchanged.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 9 June 1866, p. 4, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
Our European correspondence and files by the Africa
reached this city from Boston yesterday evening. The
papers are dated to the 26th of May, and contain in-
teresting details of our telegraphic report from Halifax.
